item.tib: rtsa gsum gnad kyis bsgrubs mchog bsam 'phel nor bu
item.coloph: zhi khro dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i lha bsgrubs (sgrub)/ bsam 'phel nor bu'i 'phreng (phreng) ba zhes bya ba/ bla chen dran pas phyi rab (rabs) don du gsungs nas/ dmu tsa gyer med la gdams/ phyi rab (rabs) las ldan gshen la brgyad pa ni/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong srungs (srung) ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas sku thobs (thob) shog/
